instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Regional public health authority responsible for epidemiological surveillance, health promotion programs, and healthcare resource planning for a region of 1.2 million inhabitants. Managing 15 public health programs. Key innovation priority is real-time disease surveillance using syndromic data integration from primary care and hospital networks across multiple geographies.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our engineering team adopted an agile methodology last year, moving from waterfall-style quarterly releases to 2-week sprints with continuous deployment. This reduced our release cycle time by 60% and improved cross-functional collaboration. However, adjacent teams like clinical operations and public communication are still adapting to the faster cadence.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has mandated that 25% of revenue should come from products or services that did not exist 3 years ago. This requires us to systematically explore adjacent markets, new customer segments, and alternative monetization models. We are open to both organic build initiatives and strategic acquisitions of small, innovative companies that can serve as diversification platforms.
answers.additionalContext: The authority faces intense pressure from private sector health tech startups and regional commercial entities. Success hinges on balancing public service mandates with the need for scalable, market-driven solutions.
answers.teamSize: Innovation is decentralized across business units, each with its own innovation lead and dedicated resources, coordinated by a group-level Chief Innovation Officer. The total innovation workforce is approximately 100 people across the organization. A group innovation fund of €5M annually is allocated competitively — business units pitch for funding against clear innovation KPIs including revenue from new products and process efficiency gains.

opportunities.title: Streamlined Data Visualization Platform (Internal Efficiency)
opportunities.rationale: Implementing a modular data visualization layer using existing digital maturity allows for quick internal process improvements without significant external risk. This incremental change will standardize reporting across business units, reducing manual data processing time and improving operational efficiency.

first_actions: Pilot the new visualization framework in one key disease surveillance unit.
Integrate existing talent into a focused 3-month sprint team.
Develop comprehensive training materials for relevant staff.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce monthly reporting generation time by 30%.
milestones: Full rollout to three major programs within Q2.

opportunities.title: Strategic Entry into Commercial Health SaaS (Diversification)
opportunities.rationale: Given the bold risk appetite and strategic goal of diversification, exploring a partnership or acquisition of a specialized health tech firm is crucial. This radical move allows the authority to leverage its unique real-time epidemiological data asset into a scalable commercial B2B product offering.

first_actions: Conduct an external landscape analysis identifying 5 potential acquisition targets.
Establish a dedicated M&A steering committee with legal and clinical experts.
Allocate initial $1M exploratory fund for due diligence on top two candidates.
resources_needed: Initial seed funding for acquisition target assessment ($1M)
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful identification and agreement on at least one strategic partnership or acquisition within 12 months.
milestones: Completion of market analysis and target list (Q3).
Finalize commercial/legal terms for pilot project negotiation (Q4).

next_steps.action: Formalize the M&A due diligence framework and secure initial legal counsel for potential acquisitions.
Launch a focused internal task force to evaluate vendor solutions for the data visualization platform pilot.
Conduct cross-functional workshops (Ops, Marketing) to map friction points in our current agile process adoption.

key_weaknesses: Siloed organizational culture hinders cross-departmental adoption of new technologies and methodologies.
Slow, bureaucratic procurement cycles bottleneck the deployment of innovative solutions.
High dependency on specific senior talent makes scaling innovation difficult due to limited internal expertise in commercialization.
Inconsistent application of agile processes across different business units leads to varied innovation success rates.
